review_reference: NOT SIGNED. 0117 (recorded allergies and allergy-warning acknowledgements), numbered 0124 when written (the EHR clinical-safety lane's number) and renumbered 0117 on 2026-11-11 by the release order the coordinator fixed. reviewed_by stays empty until the owner reads this declaration and signs it here under 0117; nothing in this branch signs it.
evidence: Single migration 0117_recorded_allergies.sql (numbered 0124 when written; renumbered 0117 on 2026-11-11 by the release order; unsigned until the owner signs). WHAT IT DOES: two new tables, nothing else. (1) ehr.recorded_allergies: an allergy a clinician recorded for a patient at a facility (substance 1-200 trimmed characters without control characters, reaction 1-500 or null, severity mild/moderate/severe/unknown, created_by and created_by_membership_id bound to the facility by the membership foreign key), status active or entered_in_error (who, when, reason 3-500; all three exactly when entered_in_error). ehr.guard_recorded_allergy_update (new, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pg_catalog, pg_temp, no grant) allows exactly one change, active to entered_in_error by the acting account, and stamps entered_in_error_at; 0004's ehr.capture_record_version versions the insert and the marking (the marking needs app.change_reason, the entered-in-error reason); platform.reject_mutation refuses DELETE. (2) ehr.prescription_allergy_acknowledgements: append-only, one or more per prescription, each with its stage (create, activate, resume or send: Activate, Resume and sending a draft to another facility check the allergies again), indexed on prescription_id, the prescriber's reason 10-500 trimmed characters, the patient's own terms that matched (normalized, text[] default '{}', at most 50, no null), the ids of the recorded allergies that matched and whether the patient-reported allergies matched (at least one of the two); foreign key (prescription_id, patient_id, facility_id) to ehr.prescriptions; 0005's ehr.validate_append_only_clinical_actor checks attribution; platform.reject_mutation refuses UPDATE and DELETE. RLS forced on both: recorded allergies read under ehr.imported_record_read_context(patient_id) (patient-self, or a clinician with read access to the patient at the current facility, as 0094's patient-reported profile: an allergy follows the patient to every facility the patient gave access to), inserted (status active only) and updated under ehr.context_allows(patient_id, facility_id, 'write_records') (the recording facility only); acknowledgements read and inserted at their own facility (read_records, write_records). Grants (migration and runtime-grants.sql alike): SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on ehr.recorded_allergies and SELECT, INSERT on ehr.prescription_allergy_acknowledgements to hid_ehr_runtime and hid_schema_test_runtime; none to PUBLIC; no DELETE. PRECONDITIONS (catalog reads only; 55000, nothing applied): the tables and functions referred to exist ('0117: 0001-0094 must be applied first'); neither table nor the guard function exists ('0117: already applied'). BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: new objects only; no existing table, column, constraint, policy, function, trigger or grant changes; today's services never read the new tables. SERVICE ORDER: the ehr-api that ships with 0117 checks allergies at prescription create, Activate, Resume and send of a draft, and refuses a match without an allergyAcknowledgement carrying the current warningToken (409 ALLERGY_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_REQUIRED); the website that sends the acknowledgement (health, claude/ehr-allergies-web) must be live first. EMERGENCY READ: the emergency (break-glass) read answers the allergies: no policy change is needed, because 0117's read policy (ehr.imported_record_read_context) and 0094's patient-reported read policy go through ehr.context_allows at the current facility, which admits 0012/0104's reasoned break-glass grant for read_records under purpose emergency; recorded-allergies.integration.sql section 7 proves it (an emergency doctor with only a break-glass grant reads every facility's recorded allergies and the patient's text, writes nothing, marks nothing, reads no acknowledgement, and under direct care reads nothing). The prescription reads answer the stored acknowledgements under 0117's existing read policy (their own facility, read_records).
